subject.title: Evaluate GitNexus-backed context for ClawSweeper cost, speed, and review accuracy

question: Should the GitNexus/Voyage adoption guide in https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/443 land before the default-off hook in https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/440 is accepted, or wait for that hook/security-boundary decision first?
rationale: The issue asks ClawSweeper to publish guidance for optional graph context, provider credentials, refresh operations, stale-index handling, and secret-output fail-closed behavior, which needs maintainer intent before it becomes core operational guidance.

options.title: Wait For Hook Decision
options.body: Hold the adoption guide until maintainers accept or narrow the default-off GitNexus hook so the guide describes an approved boundary.

options.title: Merge As Proposal Now
options.body: Land the docs now only if maintainers are comfortable publishing them as proposal-only guidance that clearly says the hook is not current-main behavior.

options.title: Pause GitNexus Adoption
options.body: Keep or close the direction if maintainers do not want GitNexus/Voyage guidance in ClawSweeper core docs.

recommendation.title: Wait For Hook Decision
recommendation.body: Hold the adoption guide until maintainers accept or narrow the default-off GitNexus hook so the guide describes an approved boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent adjacent history on local review, runtime bounds, toolchain, and automation surfaces affected by the operational guidance.
